situations.headline: Frontier Energy (FHE) – Waroona Stage One construction mobilisation begins

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Frontier Energy (FHE) – Waroona Stage One construction mobilisation begins (interest 6, risk 3)

thesis.text: Frontier Energy is a single-asset WA renewable developer transitioning its flagship Waroona Project (132MW solar + 81.5MW/6.9hr BESS) from development into a funded two-year construction phase with an experienced Owner's Team and EPC partner Monford Group, targeting first generation in 2028; near-term catalysts are construction milestones (piling, panel installation) rather than financial events, with execution risk being the primary variable to monitor.
